---
title: "⌨️ Command-line scripts"
---

With the `krsim` environment active, run the five main stages of the [quick start](quickstart.qmd) example from a terminal. Results go to `krsim_tutorial_output/` in the current folder (krsim creates it):

```bash
OUT=krsim_tutorial_output

krsim simulate   --Nh 3 --T 10 --K 2 --chi 0.18 --C 1 --random_seed 123 --output_dir $OUT
krsim mutate     --ts $OUT/ts_123.trees --random_seed 123 --output_dir $OUT
krsim coal-mut   --ts $OUT/ts_mut_123.trees --random_seed 123 --output_dir $OUT
krsim vcf-strain --ts $OUT/ts_mut_123.trees --random_seed 123 --output_dir $OUT
```

For the host VCF (stage 5), use either command. Both read the same strain VCF, so you can also run both. `vcf-host` gives every host the same read depth (`--depth`) at every site:

```bash
krsim vcf-host   --strain_vcf $OUT/output_123_strain.vcf --ind_node_map_csv $OUT/sim_ind_node_map_123.csv \
                 --depth 10 --random_seed 123 --output_dir $OUT
```

`vcf-host-depth` gives each host the [realistic read depth](realistic-depth.qmd) of a real sample. It reads a zip of depth files, one per host or more; download a small one with three Pf8 samples from this website first:

```bash
curl -O https://mrc-ide.github.io/KR_simulator/data/tutorial_depth.zip

krsim vcf-host-depth --strain_vcf $OUT/output_123_strain.vcf --ind_node_map_csv $OUT/sim_ind_node_map_123.csv \
                     --depth_zip tutorial_depth.zip --random_seed 123 --output_dir $OUT
```

Each command prints the files it wrote. Every file name ends in the random seed (`123` here), and every command adds a record of what it ran to `KR_sim_123.log`.

| Command | Reads | Writes |
|---|---|---|
| `simulate` | — | `ts_123.trees`, `sim_ind_node_map_123.csv` |
| `mutate` | `ts_123.trees` | `ts_mut_123.trees` |
| `coal-mut` | `ts_mut_123.trees` | `coal_T_123.csv`, `mut_T_123.csv` |
| `vcf-strain` | `ts_mut_123.trees` | `output_123_strain.vcf` |
| `vcf-host` | `output_123_strain.vcf`, `sim_ind_node_map_123.csv` | `output_123_host.vcf` |
| `vcf-host-depth` | `output_123_strain.vcf`, `sim_ind_node_map_123.csv`, `tutorial_depth.zip` | `output_123_host_depth.vcf`, `host_depth_profiles_123.csv`, `host_depth_proportions_123.csv` |

See the [command-line reference](commands.qmd) for every option.
